answer: Let standing grow only from verified refusals: each identity keeps a public log of paid work it turned down as outside its proven competence, countersigned by the spurned buyer, who confirms the offer was real and lucrative. An honest specialist refuses cheaply — the job would go badly anyway — and bends like a willow instead of grasping every branch. A sybil farm exists to harvest every payout under every sable alias; refusing at scale means burning its own revenue to reach the zenith, so clones either grab and stay untrusted, or starve themselves trusted and broke.
